checkpoint.name: Alpha 2.0 - Sprinkler Network automation
checkpoint.summary: Shipped the Grass Toucher class path, then added and deployed the first follow-up automation upgrade: Sprinkler Network.
checkpoint.note: This handoff file may be committed after the deployment commit as docs-only metadata.

implemented: Added Seed Shop item Sprinkler Network.
Sprinkler Network unlocks after Self-Seeding Nozzle.
Sprinkler Network makes Tiny Sprinkler water up to two grown patches each cycle instead of one.
Added Seed Shop quest Little Irrigation Grid for buying Sprinkler Network.
Reused the existing Sprinkler Timer icon for this first automation pass.

checks: Seed Shop displayed Sprinkler Network as unlocked in stress state.
Sprinkler Network row rendered using the existing timer icon.
Perf overlay remained healthy during smoke.

knownCaveats: Sprinkler Network reuses the Sprinkler Timer icon; a custom icon can come later.
The new automation upgrade may need cost tuning after real playtesting.
Sprinkler Network doubles sprinkler touch output.
recommendedNextSteps: Playtest early-to-mid seed pacing to see whether Sprinkler Network at 170 seeds lands too late or too early.
Consider a custom Sprinkler Network item icon.
Do not pursue offline progress; the user explicitly does not want it.
Keep testing ?stress&perf&tiles=120 after each automation expansion.
